title: Act structures: overview
description: Act structures divide stories into movements with distinct jobs.

title: Three-act structure
description: Setup, confrontation, resolution: the Western default.

title: Five-act structure
description: Shakespeare's shape: exposition, rising action, climax, falling action, denouement.

title: Kishotenketsu
description: The East Asian four-part structure: introduction, development, twist, reconciliation.

title: The hero's journey (12 steps)
description: Joseph Campbell's monomyth, popularized for writers by Christopher Vogler.

title: The eight-sequence structure
description: Silent-film-era method: eight 15-minute sequences, each with its own arc.

title: Save the Cat beats
description: Blake Snyder's beat sheet (2005) names fifteen beats from opening image to final image.

title: Hybrid structures
description: Modern stories blend systems: three acts with a kishotenketsu twist, journeys in five acts.
